paragraphs: The G300 Turbodiesel uses the OM606 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel that was fitted to the W463-generation G-Class from the 1990s through to the 2000s. It's a well-known engine among G-Class enthusiasts and restoration specialists, valued for its durability and mechanical simplicity compared to later, more complex diesel units. The OM606 is a pre-common-rail design that many owners specifically seek out for its reliability and relative ease of maintenance.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every G300 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the G300 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
